name: Edge Sainklaus
original_name: エッジ・セインクラウス
source: Edge Sainklaus is a young man who pilots Huckebein 30. He has a rough and detached personality. No one knows where he came from, and he refuses to share details on his past. But it’s likely he received intensive training for piloting mobile weapons.
